snippet.title: LUSTRA: Lachea's Tale Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your first in-depth look at gameplay from LUSTRA: Lachea’s Tale.

Explore floating islands, cast spells in real time, and build a skybound settlement as you step into Lachea’s journey - a young mage caught between personal loss and the weight of leadership.

This trailer showcases key gameplay systems:
🔹 Real-time spellcasting
🔹 Narrative choices that shape the story
🔹 Morale and resource management
🔹 Village building and community care

Made in collaboration with a psychologist, LUSTRA explores what it means to grow, lead, and carry others through uncertain times.

🪄 Wishlist on Steam now: https://replug.link/LUSTRALacheasTaleYT
